title.narrative: Up-scaling WASH systems strengthening approach in the Terai region of Nepal

description.narrative: By strengthening the governance and WASH service provision of service authorities and service providers, the project targets communities of 10 municipalities in the districts of Saptari and Siraha in the Madhesh Province, for a total population of approximatively 448.827 users (50.523 households).Marginalized and vulnerable individuals and households, communities, FCHVs, health staff, WSUCs, school committees benefitting from specific measures such as, among others, CLTS campaigns and the promotion of total sanitation, WASH behavior change, WASH awareness and MHM in schools, demonstration of WASH model infrastructures and facilities, and capacity building.Beneficiaries at meso level include 10 local governments (6 municipalities targeted in phase 1 and 4 new municipalities included in phase 2) with their elected representatives and technical departments.At macro level, the Madhesh provincial government, the WASH departments of federal government, relevant stakeholders and actors of the WASH sector will benefit through evidence-based knowledge/learning sharing on the WASH systems strengthening approach, dissemination of standardized methods and tools, technical studies and backstopping, and advocacy initiatives.

In continuity with phase 1, the overall objective of the project is “improving the health and nutritional status of the population of Siraha and Saptari districts through strengthened WASH governance and the provision of basic water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services, gender equality and empowerment of disadvantaged groups”.In the proposed phase 2, the project will continue to strengthen WASH governance at municipal level, expanding the target area from six to ten municipalities, for the provision of quality and safe water, sanitation, and hygiene services to users and with the main goal of “promoting the availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation through community engagement, WASH systems strengthening and advocacy”.

The project is built upon the learnings and achievements of the first phase project NPL1060. This project will do a close follow up and monitoring of the results achieved and provide technical backstopping for the previously strengthened governance capacity in the six municipalities- specially on the implementation of municipal-wide WASH plans-2030. At the same time, WASH systems strengthening approaches will be scale up to another four neighbouring municipalities in the Terai region.
